issue.title: C268: admit exact historical hinge endpoint bytes before comparison
issue.body:
## Scope
Implement C260 `read_bound_endpoint(repo, endpoint)` for the two recorded before/after endpoints. Require exact original source/GLB size and SHA-256, safe bounded file access, and the unchanged pinned C267 comparison. Preserve raw changed-input APIs and all physical/execution nonclaims.

Director: `c268-root-c7dae94da130`. Starting main: `b2ca38875bd7b43b85011bbc671ee9fee1682441`. Intended branch: `work/c268-historical-endpoint`.

## One phase and gates
Confirm early recovery ZIP before implementation; independent implementation/control assignments; affected component checks and separate exact-candidate review; conditional integration and actual-main checks; retained history and branch disposition; verified final online handoff saved to OntoKin, external receipt, then stop. Keep this issue open until all gates pass.

Owned paths: new `docs/engineering/localized-repair-c268/`, `docs/workflow/tasks/C268/`; Director alone owns CURRENT/STATUS under a verified lease. No runtime, semantics, budget, historical contract/fixture, or hosted workflow edits.

Next: publish requirements/plan and early recovery; actual evidence and exact candidate will be recorded here through task references.
